column1: # Engine wave W5 (18 Oct 2026, rulings R136–R138): the regional safe default for Europe without an authority or a
# mosque survey (`default.safe.europe`, Generic.kt; spec §6.2 c: Spain, Portugal, Italy, Malta, Luxembourg,
# Andorra, San Marino, the Vatican, Gibraltar), gated for the first time, as a stress test only: no table is held
# for any country it serves, so it is checked against the nearest real calendars, France's and Germany's (each
# has its own cautious entry and a survey; neither is routed here), at latitudes the region itself serves (36° to
# 50° N; Luxembourg, at 49.6°, is its northernmost country): Paris's three (Drancy, Al-Amel, the Grande Mosquée),
# Lyon's Abou Bakr, two of Marseille's, two of Munich's and Frankfurt's Masjid Indonesia, each at its own point.
# Berlin's three calendars were measured on the first pass and left out (ruling R139: a region's stress rows run at
# the latitudes it serves): at 52.5° N, north of every place the region serves, even the 15° twilight is missing in
# summer, so each cell there is one substitution rule against another, not a finding about the region; their
# figures are in BUILD-LOG (W5) for the owner. Every row is held out.
# What the rows show is the cost of the region's design (its late limits, Generic.kt, europeLateLimits): Fajr 7 to
# 37 min after the 15° to 18° dawns these calendars print (this region's Fajr is the 12° to 13° family's, the
# latest in wide European use) and up to 56 min after Munich's Diyanet calendar in summer, whose seasonal takdir
# holds its dawn early; Isha 13 to 60 min after their 12° to 17° one (this region's is the 18° + 2 min) and up to
# 144 min after it in summer north of about 45°, where the 18° dusk comes near midnight or, when the sun no longer
# reaches it, is set by the 1986 proportion; the end of eating (the 18° dawn − 2 min) 12 to 60 min before their
# Fajr and up to 134 min before it in those summers; and the floors (Paris's Dhuhr + 5 and Maghrib + 4) plus the
# cushion on the rest (Dhuhr up to 9 min after, Maghrib up to 8, Asr up to 6, sunrise up to 6 before).
# Masked cells, each a limit of the fallback for the owner (BUILD-LOG, W5), never an exception added quietly:
# - Munich's IGMG calendar (Diyanet's method): sunrise, Asr and Maghrib are not checked. Diyanet's temkin
#   (sunrise − 7, Asr + 4, Maghrib + 7) is deeper than this region's floors on each: its sunrise a minute or two
#   before the region's on 349 days (a late end), its Asr up to 3 min after on 312 days and its Maghrib up to 2 min
#   after on 121 days (starts before Diyanet's). The same definitional difference safe-default.tsv masks for
#   İstanbul; Diyanet's mosques in Italy or Luxembourg would see it, which is the owner's §6.2 c question.
# - Frankfurt's Masjid Indonesia (a 20° dawn, Kemenag's conventions): Fajr, sunrise, Asr and Maghrib are not
#   checked. In June the 20° dawn is missing at 50° N and the calendar's substitute Fajr comes after this
#   region's real 12° dawn, by up to 11 min on 39 days (a start before the calendar's; the one finding that could
#   reach a served place, Luxembourg, 0.5° further south); its sunrise is printed a minute or two before this
#   region's on 346 days (a late end), its Asr up to 3 min after on 301 days and its Maghrib up to 2 min after on
#   122 days, its own precaution minutes deeper than the region's floors. Its end of eating, Dhuhr and Isha are
#   checked.
